chunks_fts_gin: CREATE INDEX chunks_fts_gin ON z1.chunks USING gin (to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, COALESCE(content, ''::text)))
persons_name_trgm_gin: CREATE INDEX persons_name_trgm_gin ON z1.persons USING gin (search_value gin_trgm_ops)
financial_currency_merchant_btree: CREATE INDEX financial_currency_merchant_btree ON z1.financial_transactions USING btree (currency, search_value)
documents_email_object_gin: CREATE INDEX documents_email_object_gin ON z1.documents USING gin (email_fields jsonb_path_ops) WHERE ((email_fields_state = 'valid'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(email_fields) = 'object'::text))
